items.title: Anthropic Just Finished Its First Day as a Public Company. Five of the Six Biggest Tech IPOs Since Facebook Were Underwater Six Months After Theirs, and Elon Musk’s SpaceX Is Following the Script
items.summary: Warren Buffett told CNBC in 2019 that Berkshire had never bought a new issue in 54 years. Anthropic sold 980 million shares at $83, above its marketed range of $70 to $78, raising $81.3 billion, and closed its first day on the Nasdaq as ANT at $97.17, up 17% from the offer price.
